Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/coturn && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[{"step":1,"file":"src/apps/uclient/mainuclient.c","function":"main","line":188,"var":"oauth","code":"oauth = 1;","note":"The attacker-controlled command-line option -J enables OAuth mode in the client, selecting the code path that later uses key-based integrity checks."},{"step":2,"file":"src/apps/uclient/uclient.c","function":"add_integrity","line":1606,"var":"clnet_info->oauth","code":"if(oauth && clnet_info->oauth) {","note":"When OAuth is enabled for the session, the client builds an OAuth access token and then adds message integrity with a key rather than a password."},{"step":3,"file":"src/apps/uclient/uclient.c","function":"add_integrity","line":1651,"var":"message->buf","code":"if(stun_attr_add_integrity_by_key_str(message->buf, (size_t*)&(message->len), (uint8_t*)okey_array[cok].kid, clnet_info->realm, clnet_info->key, clnet_info->nonce, shatype)<0) {","note":"This appends the MESSAGE-INTEGRITY attribute to the outgoing STUN/TURN request, creating the exact message layout that the checker later verifies."},{"step":4,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"stun_check_message_integrity_by_key_str","line":1926,"var":"new_hmac","code":"uint8_t new_hmac[MAXSHASIZE];","note":"The HMAC output buffer is allocated on the stack but not initialized before use."},{"step":5,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"stun_check_message_integrity_by_key_str","line":1976,"var":"new_hmac","code":"res = stun_calculate_hmac(buf, (size_t) new_len - 4 - shasize, key, get_hmackey_size(shatype), new_hmac, &shasize, shatype);","note":"The function writes only the computed digest bytes for the selected hash size; any remaining bytes in the stack buffer stay indeterminate."},{"step":6,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"stun_check_message_integrity_by_key_str","line":1989,"var":"bcmp(old_hmac,new_hmac,shasize)","code":"if(bcmp(old_hmac,new_hmac,shasize))","note":"The checker compares the received integrity value against the stack buffer, and the comparison reads from the uninitialized bytes in new_hmac, triggering the vulnerability."}]
JSON
